David woke up at 8am.

Richard saw David buying lunch at the deli from 5pm to 6pm.
The museum was closed after 6pm.
Between what times could David have gone to the museum?

Options:
(A) 8am to 10am
(B) 11am to 4pm
(C) 10am to 11am
(D) 5pm to 6pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
